comment: Seed (genesis) membership for BashCoin. These are the bootstrap nodes and their initial balances; the list is baked into the image and identical on every node. Runtime joiners are NOT listed here -- they announce themselves via node-join ledger records (see join-network.sh) and are discovered from the ledger. 'host' is the peer's DNS name and MUST match the docker-compose service name.

policy.comment: Admission control for runtime joins. max_join_balance caps the coins a node-join may mint (0 = joiners start with nothing and must be funded by existing holders; keeps the genesis supply fixed). allowed_joiners, if non-empty, restricts which node ids may join.
